name: Total Roblox Drama
desc:
Welcome to ROBLOX's most dramatic game show: Total Roblox Drama! 
The only fan game authorised by Fresh TV, the creators of Total Drama Island! 
Play anonymously while you're put through some crazy challenges. 
You'll need to make friends, utilise your skills & create alliances in order to survive and win the grand prize.
Do you have what it takes to be the winner of... Total Roblox Drama?!?
